module.title: Marketing Automation, Journeys and Attribution
module.business_purpose: Multi-channel marketing on top of the CRM (module 49), the messaging fabric (module 35) and the loyalty/promotions engine (module 51). Defines audience segments, marketing campaigns and their members, multi-step journeys/flows with triggers and waits, reusable content templates, trackable UTM links, and multi-touch attribution. Ties campaigns to paid advertising (module 43 ads) and to promotions so spend, reach and conversions are measurable end to end. Consent-gated; no clinical PHI is used for targeting.
